abstract: BACKGROUND: Benign struma ovarii (SO) with synchronous ascites and elevated CA125 level is extremely rare that the incidence, clinical characteristics, and risk factors remain unclear. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective study of patients with SO treated in our hospital between 1980 and 2022. Logistic regression was used to identify potential risk factors for SO patients presenting with ascites and elevated CA125 levels. The receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve was used to evaluate the predictive performance of the identified risk factors. RESULTS: A total of 21 patients with synchronous ascites and elevated CA125 levels were identified in 229 patients with SO, the crude incidence rate was 9.17%, and four patients (1.75%) had pseudo-Meigs' syndrome. Ascites were completely involuted within 1 month postoperatively and the serum CA125 level decreased to normal between 3 d and 6 weeks after surgery. Multivariate logistic regression showed that age ≥49 years (OR 3.71, 95% CI 1.29 - 10.64, p = 0.015), tumor size ≥10.0 cm (OR 8.79, 95% CI 3.05 - 25.35, p < 0.001), and proliferative SO (OR 11.16, 95% CI 3.01 - 41.47, p < 0.001) were the independent risk factors for patients presenting ascites and elevated CA 125 level. The ROC curve revealed that the predictive performance for age and tumor size was unsatisfactory with an area under the curve (AUC) was 0.646 and 0.682, respectively. Linear regression demonstrated that the serum CA125 level has a moderate positive correlation with the volume of ascites (log(2)(CA125) = 0.6272*log(2)(ascites) + 2.099, p = 0.0001, R(2) = 0.5576). CONCLUSIONS: Less than one-tenth of patients with SO would present ascites and elevated CA125 levels, while age ≥49 years, tumor sizes ≥10 cm, and the presence of proliferative SO were the risk factors.
abstract_ja:
BACKGROUND: 同時性の腹水およびCA125値上昇を伴う良性卵巣甲状腺腫(SO)は極めてまれであり、その発生頻度、臨床的特徴、危険因子は不明である。
METHODS: 1980年から2022年の間に当院で治療されたSO患者を対象に後方視的研究を実施した。ロジスティック回帰を用いて、腹水およびCA125値上昇を呈するSO患者の潜在的な危険因子を同定した。受信者動作特性(ROC)曲線を用いて、同定された危険因子の予測性能を評価した。
RESULTS: SO患者229例のうち、同時性の腹水およびCA125値上昇を有する21例が同定され、粗発生率は9.17%であった。4例(1.75%)は偽Meigs症候群を有していた。腹水は術後1か月以内にすべて消失し、血清CA125値は術後3日から6週間の間に正常値まで低下した。多変量ロジスティック回帰では、年齢49歳以上(OR 3.71、95%CI 1.29-10.64、p = 0.015)、腫瘍径10.0cm以上(OR 8.79、95%CI 3.05-25.35、p < 0.001)、増殖性SO(OR 11.16、95%CI 3.01-41.47、p < 0.001)が、腹水およびCA125値上昇を呈する患者の独立した危険因子であった。ROC曲線では、年齢および腫瘍径の予測性能は、曲線下面積(AUC)がそれぞれ0.646および0.682と不十分であった。線形回帰では、血清CA125値は腹水量と中等度の正の相関を示した(log(2)(CA125) = 0.6272*log(2)(ascites) + 2.099、p = 0.0001、R(2) = 0.5576)。
CONCLUSIONS: SO患者のうち10%未満が腹水およびCA125値上昇を呈すると考えられ、年齢49歳以上、腫瘍径10cm以上、増殖性SOの存在が危険因子であった。
